shadows.name: card-dark
shadows.purpose: Same profile-card shadow geometry, with stronger opacity for the dark canvas.

components.name: Add new profile
components.description: Left-aligned titlebar action; profile creation is currently a placeholder.
components.html: <button class="ds-add-profile" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" /></svg>Add new profile</button>
components.css: .ds-add-profile { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #ced4da); border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #212529); font-family: InterVariable, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 550; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-add-profile svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-add-profile:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #e9ecef); } .ds-add-profile:active { background: var(--surface-active, #e4edf5); } .ds-add-profile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1c5d99); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Window controls
components.description: Postika-derived minimize, maximize, and close controls. This documentation preview is static; the app uses Wails runtime calls.
components.css: .ds-window-controls { display: flex; height: 48px; } .ds-window-controls button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #495057); cursor: pointer; } .ds-window-controls svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: currentColor; pointer-events: none; } .ds-window-controls button:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #e9ecef); color: var(--text, #212529); } .ds-window-controls .ds-close:hover { background: var(--danger-solid, #c94442); color: var(--on-danger, #ffffff); } .ds-window-controls button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1c5d99); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-window-controls button:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .5; }

narrative.overview: Postika-derived window layout and Inter, using neutral surfaces from Coolors Light Steel and blue action colors from Midnight Sky. Selected from 192 palettes across four popular/black pages; see frontend/theme-sources/coolors-review.json.
dos: Do preserve Postika's Inter font files, palette, and window-control styling when maintaining this shell.
Do keep the profile action left and native window controls right.
donts: Don't infer future profile behavior or workspace content from this initial shell.
